description: The duration an entry stays valid after being written, acting as a safety net against missed invalidation.
The Redis setting that decides whether a full server rejects writes or evicts keys such as the least recently used.
Removing or updating cached entries by time, by the write path or by an event from another module.
A burst of identical requests that all miss at once after a popular entry expires and hit the database together.
A random amount added to each time to live so entries written together do not expire together.
Repeated requests for keys that never exist, which always miss and reach the database.
